title: API-first compact playbook: onboarding screen mockset for auth, keys, streaming & toolflows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, developer-focused mockset of onboarding screens and digestible assets for the API/SDK quickstart docs. Deliver a single-page compact playbook that can be embedded in docs and used as marketing screenshots: - Auth & key setup microflow (one-line code + UI spotlight) - Streaming response terminal (animated micro-GIF showing chunked tokens + reconnect state) - Tool calling sequence card (request -> tool invocation -> structured JSON response) - Minimal code snippets for JS, Python, and curl that fit in a single screenshot. The goal is to produce lightweight PNG/JPEG exports and short GIFs (1.5–2s loop) optimized for docs and release notes. Ensure visuals align with Console color tokens and accessibility contrast guidelines. Provide final assets plus Figma file and an asset manifest for the docs team.
acceptance_criteria: One compact single-page mockset in Figma with defined layout regions for auth, keys, streaming, and tool-calling
Exported assets: 3 static screenshots (1200x628), 2 micro-GIFs (max 2MB), and responsive SVG card for docs header
Code snippets included for JS/Python/curl with copy-ready formatting and syntax highlighting matching SDK theme
Design tokens documented and a short style guide (spacing, fonts, color tokens) for engineering handoff
Reviewed and sign-off by PM (Nora Kim) and Eng owner (Ravi Desai) with at most two rounds of revisions

notes_for_engineering: Provide 2 variants of code snippet: 'beginner' (one-line client) and 'production' (explicit retry/backoff).
Streaming GIFs should visually indicate reconnection attempts and buffering to match runtime retry semantics.
Tool-calling card must show structured output intent with 'type' and 'args' fields to encourage typed tool contracts.
Create an asset manifest JSON (flat) listing file names, dimensions, and intended doc usage.
Coordinate final exports with docs CI to ensure images are under 1.5MB for CDN caching.
